# People Atlas 0.12.1 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.12.1 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.12.1 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

0.12.1 fixes the "Mijn persoon" dropdown on mobile and adds a manual index rebuild command.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **Fix "Mijn persoon" dropdown on mobile:** the dropdown now shows all indexed people (consistent with the relationship form person pickers), instead of filtering out all entries when any duplicate ID exists. Validation still happens at save time via the warning message.
- **Add "Rebuild People Atlas index" command:** available in the command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+P) for manual index rebuild — especially useful on mobile where the initial vault scan may run before the vault is fully mounted.
- **i18n support** for the new command in English and Dutch.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.12.1 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
